pages.title: Method
pages.content:
Method

Five stages over a typical five-week study: brief, recruit, interview, chart on paper, readout and written report.

pages.title: Studies
pages.content:
Studies

Three recent studies, with clients anonymised: a grocery co-op, a bicycle maker and a library network.

pages.title: Fees

Fees

Five study types, priced in USD. Prices exclude VAT and participant incentives.

People

pages.title: About

About

Shirabe Research was founded in 2012 by Clara Wendt as an independent, qualitative-first market research practice.
